== Consolation results source notes ==

The Saturday and Sunday consolation standings were added from the complete forum posts [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18352 Saturday] and [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322 Sunday]. The earlier preservation cache stopped both posts at4,000characters. Complete originals and exact normalized-prefix comparisons are independently backed under SWCCG Work task626.

The Saturday standings list Joe Olson at4(+9), while the same post's later command-card transcription says4(−12). The article follows the numbered standings list and records the disagreement here. The Sunday post's original handle-order list intermixes dropped players; the article follows its later explicitly numbered full-name standings, retaining the dropped notes.

Printed variants Jeff Johns, Steve Yeager, Dave Runyon, Joe Strelechii, Nicolae Borata and Pat Ziagos link to the existing Jeffrey Johns, Steve Yaeger, David Runyon, Joe Streleckis, Nicolae Borota and Patrick Ziagos articles. Original spellings remain unchanged in the source copies. No player identity was inferred from a photograph.

The five existing gallery captions were shortened to linked people and event/context under the current caption standard. Image files, framing and gallery membership were unchanged. The unidentified opponent previously called Hollingsworth was not promoted to a specific player identity; that source context remains in the File title.
